english.note: Use this before an emphatic evaluation, meaning absolutely or positively, as in “simply wonderful.”
Use 簡直 for emphatic “absolutely” or “utterly,” especially before a strongly negative or extreme statement.

examples.jyutping: ni1 tou3 hei3 gaan2 zik6 hou2 zing3

examples.english: This arrangement is positively a disaster.
examples.traditional: 呢個安排簡直係一場災難。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 on1 paai4 gaan2 zik6 hai6 jat1 coeng4 zoi1 naan6
